items.title: Bat Delivering an Envelope
items.alt: A bat glides diagonally while its hind feet hold a closed cream envelope by the top edge, wings unobstructed and distinct.
items.description: A bat glides diagonally while its hind feet hold a closed cream envelope by the top edge, wings unobstructed and distinct. Useful for personal invitation accents.

items.title: Bat Carrying a Berry Basket
items.alt: A friendly bat hovers above a small basket of three broad berries, its two feet hooked around the single basket handle.
items.description: A friendly bat hovers above a small basket of three broad berries, its two feet hooked around the single basket handle. Useful for counting and story cards.

items.title: Bat Resting on a Lantern
items.alt: A bat perches atop a simple green lantern with a warm flat yellow pane, wings folded and head tilted curiously.
items.description: A bat perches atop a simple green lantern with a warm flat yellow pane, wings folded and head tilted curiously. Useful for cozy nighttime cards.
